text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $85.5k with minimal daily movement, while Ethereum is similarly flat at $2.7k, suggesting consolidation rather than directional conviction from major participants. The Fear & Greed index sits at 70 (Greed) but has declined 4 points over the past week, indicating sentiment may be cooling slightly despite elevated readings. Bitcoin's dominance at 58.7% and $83B daily volume reflect moderate engagement, with altcoins like Solana showing weakness relative to the two majors.
